Name: Broadsheet
Author: ia-presenter-know-how
ShortDescription: Bold editorial. Hero display type, one accent, generous margins.
LongDescription:
A signature house style for talk-first decks.
- Editorial serif titles, neutral sans body
- Strict 1.5 type scale; hero headings at ~19% of slide height
- One accent colour, paired per appearance so it passes contrast in both
- Dark by default; a Light preset is included
- No gradients, no decoration - the words and the images carry it
